Name: Improved Dirt and Recolored Grass for Fall
Author: Relenanator
Description:
[center][/center][center][font=Tahoma][size=4][b]WARNING![/b]

[b]WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET IS KNOWN FOR STEALING MODS! [/b][/size]

[size=3][u]If you see my mod there please don't download it.[/u] Don't download this mode from any other site but Nexus Mods or Stardew Valley | Chucklefish Forums.[/size][/font]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=2]
[font=Courier New]My mod now comes in Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, and Portuguese. More to come with each update to the game.
If you see '[b]ANYTHING'[/b] that needs fixing please let me know! The last thing I want is offend someone because of a language mistake or improper edit.[/font][/size]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[font=Times New Roman]
Like many people, I always found the dirt in Stardew Valley way too yellow but I didn't want to change the terrain so much that it took away the original feel of the valley. So, I only desaturated the dirt just enough to not be overly yellow and bright.

I also changed the grass for fall because I honestly don't like the orange grass of the original. I made the fall grass by overlaying the Spring tile sheets over the Fall tile sheets and then erasing the top layer at around 2/3's opacity.

The last few changes I made were, the garbage in Pam's yard, the pink tree for spring, and the dilapidated state of the Joja building when permanently closed.

The Deseret Oasis building has also been recolored and comes with each language pack. It was just way too magenta for me so I made it more pink.

Thank you for downloading my mod and I hope you enjoy it.[/font][/center]
